user.title: Intercom
user.description: Voice messages to the rooms of the house. {rooms} rooms with a speaker were found; you can change them later in the options.

init.title: Intercom
init.description:
Rooms now, each with its speakers in the order they are tried:

{rooms}

room.title: Room
room.description: Choose a room to change (with its speakers now), or another area to add as a room.

speakers.title: Speakers: {room}
speakers.description: The first speaker that is up plays the message. Speakers that drop streamed speech (an Apple TV / HomePod) get the whole spoken message as a file.

data_description.volume: Empty leaves the speaker's volume as it is. Voice satellites keep their own.

data_description.tts_engine: Empty: the first engine of Home Assistant.
data_description.language: Empty: the language of Home Assistant.
data_description.keep_minutes: Recorded and spoken messages are removed after this time.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The voice of the engine for typed messages and the HomePods. Voice satellites speak with their own assistant's voice.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Speaks a text, or plays a recording, in rooms: each on the first of its speakers that is up.

areas.name: Rooms
areas.description: The rooms (areas), or entities in them.

media.name: Recording
media.description: A media id to play instead of a text, e.g. media-source://media_source/local/message.wav.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: 0-1 for this message; empty uses the room's volume.
